reason: I'd love to pull this on my friends at a party, but it's not in the App Store, it installs from some browser link, and they want my card on their own website. I'd try the free tricks, but I don't pay 99 shekels until I've seen real videos and reviews and know who's behind it.
objection: Typing my card into an unknown site for an app that isn't even in the App Store or Google Play feels risky. Who are these people, and will it still work in a year?
would_change_my_mind: A friend in one of my WhatsApp groups doing the trick on me and vouching for it, plus payment through a known option like Bit, PayPal or Apple Pay instead of typing my card.
